newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian central bank says bond offer going well. [corrected 09:10 gmt 14/9]
newsitem.headline: Egyptian central bank says bond offer going well. [corrected 09:10 gmt 14/9]

text.p: Investors have applied for more than two billion pounds worth of seven-year Egyptian treasury bonds in the first five days of the 22-day offer, the central bank deputy governor was quoted as saying on Friday.
The treasury is offering four billion pounds worth of the bonds between September 8 and 30 (Corrects from 22). They will pay interest twice a year at a fixed 11 percent, exempt from tax.
Deputy governor Mohamed el-Barbari was quoted in the Saturday edition of the government newspaper Akhbar el-Yom.
